answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the glacier queue while genuine members promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 520 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the spiral. The echo index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 12 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
